'''Sarls''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of amored [[Bug (creature)|bugs]] that lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Draay 2]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A swarm of those creatures dwelled in the secret [[Jedi Temple (Draay 2)|temple]] built by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lucien Draay]] to hide a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] known as the "[[Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger|Gauntlet]] of [[Elcho Kressh|Kressh the Younger]]." They had formed a column around the Gauntlet and had become overwhelmed by the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of prolonged exposure to the artifact's energy, the sarls had become nearly invulnerable: their armored body could sustain both [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strikes. Additionally, their twin mandibles were strong enough to pierce through [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] armor. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Jedi Master [[B'ink Utrila]] confronted the sarls in the temple with her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Rennax Omani]] and a few [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], but they were forced to pull back when confronted with the bugs' near-invulnerability.
